seoTitle: Malcolm in the Middle Test: Which Character Are You? (10 Questions)
metaDescription: Take the Malcolm in the Middle test: 10 everyday questions reveal whether you're Malcolm, Lois, Hal, Francis, Reese or Dewey — with your full character breakdown.
intro: Are you the genius, the rebel, or the one who's always in charge? Answer 10 everyday questions about family, work and getting into trouble, and find out which Malcolm in the Middle character you are.

characters.name: Malcolm
characters.title: The Reluctant Genius
characters.summary: Brilliant, sarcastic and sure that life is unfair. You see the problem before anyone else, and you'll tell everyone about it.
description: Like Malcolm, you're smarter than you'd like people to notice. He has an IQ of 165, and he's moved into the Krelboynes, a class for gifted students.
You're the one with the plan. Malcolm is usually the ringleader of his brothers' schemes, even when they go badly wrong.
You're going places, whether you like it or not. By the finale, Malcolm is taking classes at Harvard, and Lois wants him to become President.
characters.flaw: You're right so often that you stop listening to anyone else.
characters.signature: A sarcastic comment, a clever plan and a look that says 'Why me?'
characters.clashReason: they'd point out every flaw in your plan, out loud

characters.name: Lois
characters.title: The Boss of the House
characters.summary: Fierce, sharp and always in charge. Nothing gets past you, and you don't back down.
description: Like Lois, you run a tight ship. She's the strict, hot-tempered mother of five boys, and she almost never admits she's wrong.
You work hard. Lois works at the Lucky Aide drugstore alongside Craig, who has a huge crush on her.
You had other dreams once. Before she married Hal, Lois planned to go to music school and become a concert violinist.
characters.flaw: You'd rather win the argument than admit you got it wrong.
characters.signature: A raised voice, a sixth sense for lies and the final word.
characters.clashReason: they'd catch you in a lie before you'd finished telling it

characters.name: Hal
characters.title: The Big Kid
characters.summary: Loving, excitable and a little chaotic. You throw yourself into everything, until the next thing comes along.
description: Like Hal, you're a big kid at heart. He's the boys' laid-back dad, and he usually lets Lois make the big decisions.
You go all in. Hal gets hooked on one hobby after another, from roller skating to competitive speed walking.
You put up with a lot. Hal works in lower management at a company he's always hated.
characters.flaw: You go all in on a new obsession, then drop it a month later.
characters.signature: A brand-new hobby, a nervous laugh and far too much enthusiasm.
characters.clashReason: they'd rope you into their latest obsession whether you wanted in or not

characters.name: Francis
characters.title: The Rebel
characters.summary: Independent, defiant and never one for rules. You'd rather do things your own way, a long way from home.
description: Like Francis, you were born to push back. He's the oldest brother, and Lois sends him away to Marlin Academy, a military school.
You'll go a long way to be free. Francis runs away from the academy, goes to work in Alaska and marries Piama there.
You hate being told what to do. Francis is always fighting with Lois, and in the finale he even hides from her that he's taken an office job.
characters.flaw: You'd rather rebel than admit someone else had a point.
characters.signature: A road out of town, a grudge against authority and a story about the time you got away with it.
characters.clashReason: they'd talk you into breaking the rules, then leave you to take the blame

characters.name: Reese
characters.title: The Wild Card
characters.summary: Tough, impulsive and secretly talented. You act first and think later, if at all.
description: Like Reese, you act first and think later. He's the school's top bully, and he's the brother who gets punished most.
You have a hidden talent. Reese is a brilliant cook, and he's put in charge of the family's holiday meals.
You don't always see trouble coming. Reese once tries to join the army using a fake ID.
characters.flaw: You leap before you look, every single time.
characters.signature: A clenched fist, a big grin and a perfect homemade dinner.
characters.clashReason: they'd start a fight and drag you into it

characters.name: Dewey
characters.title: The Quiet Prodigy
characters.summary: Quiet, creative and much smarter than people realize. You notice everything, and you remember it.
description: Like Dewey, people underestimate you. He starts out as the quiet, picked-on youngest brother, and grows up to be as sneaky as the rest of them.
You have a gift. Dewey is a musical prodigy, and he even writes an opera about his parents' fight over a new bed.
You look out for others. Dewey is put in a class for troubled students by mistake, and he ends up as its unofficial teacher.
characters.flaw: You never forget a slight, and you get even when nobody expects it.
characters.signature: A song in your head, a quiet smile and a very long memory.
characters.clashReason: they'd say nothing, then get you back weeks later

questions.text: At a family barbecue, the grill catches fire. You...

options.text: Explain, at length, why it isn't your fault
Take charge and tell everyone exactly what to do
Panic, then make it worse trying to fix it
Quietly put it out while everyone else argues

questions.text: Your boss brings in a new rule that makes no sense. You...

options.text: Ignore it, and see if anyone notices
Follow it, but complain to anyone who'll listen
March into their office and tell them why it's wrong
Go along with it. It's not worth the fight

questions.text: You have a free Sunday with no plans. You...

options.text: Have a few friends over for a long game of poker
Cook something big and impressive for everyone
Get out of the house, as far away as you can
Stay in with your headphones and make something of your own

questions.text: Someone in your family has clearly lied to you. You...

options.text: Know it straight away, and get the truth out of them
Pretend you believe them, and save it for later
Poke holes in their story, out loud
Let it go. You'd rather not know

questions.text: A stranger is rude to you in a store. You...

options.text: Square up to them before you've thought it through
Hit back with a comment that leaves them speechless
Make a scene they'll never forget
Walk away. They're not worth it

questions.text: A friend asks you to help them move on Saturday. You...

options.text: Say yes, and turn up with far too much enthusiasm and a plan
Say yes, and carry the heaviest things because you can
Tell them you're busy. You're always busy
Turn up, then tell them they're packing it all wrong

questions.text: Your town starts offering free evening classes. You...

options.text: Sign up for music lessons, and practice every night
Sign up for something unusual, and be obsessed with it for a month
Take self-defense, mostly to try it out on people
Go to one class, then never go back

questions.text: Your manager gives you a bad review at work. You...

options.text: Argue every single point until they back down
Take it, then work twice as hard to prove them wrong
Decide the whole system is rigged and stop trying
Don't really notice until someone points it out

questions.text: You're one of five brothers, and Mom catches you all doing something you shouldn't. You...

options.text: Come up with a cover story on the spot
Take the punishment. You're used to it
Calmly point out that you were only watching
Admit it proudly. You'd do it again

questions.text: You're raising boys who keep wrecking the house. You...

options.text: Lay down the law, so they know exactly who's boss
Secretly find it a bit funny, then back up your partner
Work out a system so it can't happen again
Remember you were worse, and go easy on them
